description: Get full detail for one product by its id: price, normalized unit price, size, bulk/staffel tiers, buy link, and recent price history. Use the id returned by find_cheapest or search_products.

market.description: Optional country market to query: nl, be. Defaults to the market of the requested domain. Any other value is rejected.

product_id.description: The numeric product id, as returned in the `id` field by find_cheapest or search_products.

name: get_product
title: Get Product Tool
